verdict.rationale: Three.js ships monthly-versioned releases with release notes and a Migration Guide documenting breaking changes (threejs-docs-10, threejs-gh-6, threejs-docs-17, threejs-docs-11/12), giving some traceability across versions, but there is no evidence of an explicit deprecation policy (e.g. warning periods before removal) — the Migration Guide is reactive documentation of already-made breaking changes rather than a forward deprecation commitment. missing for 10: an explicit stated deprecation policy, deprecation warnings/timelines, semver-style stability guarantees.
